name: delegate-body-trigger-tap
description: On a phone-width viewport the two-level body trigger sometimes is the row's ONLY control (a summary-less delegate row, #1253) and must meet the --tap-min touch floor (tokens.css, decision 4), not be a bare 14px chevron. At 390px the trigger is at least 44x44, its center is owned by its own button, and the bare intent still shares its first line - so the max-width reservation also reserves the trigger's grown --tap-min width rather than just the desktop chevron.

mutation.note: Without the phone block the trigger measures the chevron's ~14px box in both axes, below the 44px tap floor.
